decor:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent GROUND-DECORATION sprite atlas for a top-down Unity high-detail pixel-art forest RPG. These are small flat details lying on the ground that break up texture repetition; they have no collision and the player walks over them.
Canvas 1536x1536 with a fully transparent alpha background. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows = 16 separate sprites, each centered in its own 384x384 cell with generous fully transparent margins; nothing crosses cell borders, no overlaps.
Row 1: three different short wild grass tufts (emerald/teal blades, a few olive tips), and one cluster of clover with tiny ivory flowers.
Row 2: a scatter of fallen autumn-gold and olive leaves; a scatter of fallen dark green leaves with a twig; a small group of flat grey-blue pebbles with moss; a short broken dry branch.
Row 3: a patch of tiny ivory wildflowers; a patch of tiny golden wildflowers; a patch of tiny blue-violet bell flowers; a small fairy ring of tiny golden-cream mushrooms.
Row 4: a flat patch of bright moss; exposed gnarled tree roots lying flat on the ground; a small shallow puddle reflecting teal sky light with a mossy rim; a cluster of fern sprouts.
All sprites are LOW and FLAT, seen from almost straight above with slight three-quarter tilt matching the reference objects, each about 30-55% of its cell, crisp deliberate clustered pixels, colored dark outlines, no drop shadows larger than a faint 1-2 pixel contact shade. Medium values so they read on both the green forest floor and the brown dirt path without strong contrast. No text, labels, grid lines, checkerboard, floor, backdrop or characters.

No characters, no floor, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no checkerboard. Transparent alpha preserved.
edges:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent TERRAIN-EDGE overlay sprite atlas. In the game a dirt path (earth-path.png) is cut into a grass floor (forest-floor.png) on a square grid, which leaves hard straight/stepped borders. These overlay sprites are placed straddling that border line to hide it: each is an elongated irregular band of grass blades, moss, tiny roots, a few pebbles and crumbs of soil that spills over the edge in an organic wavy line. Colors must match the grass texture (deep emerald, teal moss, olive tips) on one side and blend into the brown dirt with sparse soil crumbs on the other.
Orientation for every band: the GRASS side is at the TOP of the sprite and grass blades and moss tongues spill DOWNWARD onto dirt; the bottom edge is a ragged wavy fringe of blades and soil crumbs fading out. Viewed strictly from above (orthographic top-down), no perspective, no horizon, no cast shadows except a faint soft darker soil line under the fringe.
Canvas 1536x1536 with a fully transparent alpha background, exactly 2 columns by 4 rows = 8 separate sprites, each centered in its own 768x384 cell with transparent margins of at least 24 px; nothing crosses cell borders.
Rows 1-3: six different horizontal edge bands, each roughly 90% of the cell width and 45-60% of the cell height, both short ends tapering to nothing so bands can overlap each other seamlessly along a long edge. Vary the shapes: some with small fern sprouts, one with a few tiny ivory flowers, one with a small mossy root.
Row 4: two rounded corner clumps (grass mound shaped like a quarter-circle tongue spilling down and to the right, and one spilling down and to the left), about 55% of cell width.
Crisp deliberate clustered pixels matching the references, no smooth painting. No text, labels, grid lines, checkerboard or characters.
floor:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: seamless repeating GROUND TEXTURE for the boss arena and the ancient ruins area of a top-down Unity high-detail pixel-art forest game. Match the stone of woodland-ruins.png (blue-slate weathered stone with antique bronze/gold accents) and the same pixel density as forest-floor.png.
Draw an ANCIENT FLAGSTONE FLOOR viewed strictly vertically from above: irregular worn rectangular and square slate slabs of varied sizes, thin dark joints filled with teal moss and tiny grass, a few chipped corners and hairline cracks, sparse tiny ivory flowers and fallen leaves in some joints, very rare small inlaid bronze fragments. Quiet, gameplay-readable, medium value (not darker than the grass texture), slightly cool blue-grey with warm moss, no strong contrast, no large single motif.
Square 1024x1024, entirely opaque full bleed. EXACT seamless periodic texture: left and right edges match identically, top and bottom match identically, no border, vignette, central medallion or lighting gradient. Draw it with the density of a 64x64 logical pixel tile, each logical pixel a clean square cluster; crisp hand-placed pixel clusters, not photography or oil painting. No perspective, no directional shadows, no walls, pillars, objects, text or labels.
